body:
I find this awkward still. "Generic elements" is not a term of art the HTML Standard has used thus far. Custom elements can be made accessible without ARIA attributes (using `ElementInternals`).

I'd rather we remove this paragraph and have a requirement somewhere along these lines:

> When using `popover` on elements without accessibility semantics, authors should use the appropriate ARIA attributes to ensure the popover is fully accessible.

(This cannot be part of an example due to "should".)
